**Professional Experience**

Pioneered data visualization dashboards with Plotly, enabling stakeholders to track key metrics across 15+ clinics. Developed data visualization tools with Matplotlib to communicate findings to non-technical teams, driving 30% increase in cross-departmental collaboration. Implemented XGBoost models for anomaly detection, reducing false positives by 22% in sensor data validation.

Created ETL processes for clinical trial data, ensuring compliance with HIPAA standards. Built foundational Python scripts for data cleaning, later expanded into production-grade pipelines.
